name: geo-fanout-tracer
description: Traces how one question expands into AI search queries, which sources the search returned, and which pages the final answer actually cited — then exports a self-contained offline evidence report. Records only what the OpenAI Responses API returns; never infers hidden searches.

displayDescription.en: Trace how one question expands into AI search queries, which sources were returned, and which pages the final answer cited — exported as an offline evidence report.
displayDescription.zh: 把一个问题扔进 AI 搜索，抓回它被展开成哪些搜索词、搜到哪些来源、答案最终引用了谁。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我跑一次 fan-out 取证，看看这个问题被 AI 展开成哪些搜索词
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run a fan-out trace and show how this question expands into search queries

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我跑一次 fan-out 取证，看看这个问题被 AI 展开成哪些搜索词
quickPrompts.en: Run a fan-out trace and show how this question expands into search queries

quickPrompts.zh: 对比这几个问题的 fan-out 结果，找出我站内还没覆盖的主题缺口
quickPrompts.en: Compare fan-out results across questions and find topic gaps my site has not covered

quickPrompts.zh: 用已保存的 raw-response.json 重新解析，离线重建取证报告
quickPrompts.en: Reparse a saved raw-response.json and rebuild the evidence report offline
